    Ported from TauCeti (TauCeti.RepresentationTheory.Quiver.AffineE6.FiniteRepType, commit 580b6f9d5, Apache 2.0).

    The extended Dynkin quiver E₆~ has infinite representation type #

    The quiver LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.Quiver.AffineE6, whose underlying graph is the extended Dynkin diagram E₆~, has infinitely many finite-dimensional indecomposable representations over every field (LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.not_isFiniteRepType_affineE6).

    The proof reduces to the loop quiver •↺, which is already known to have infinite representation type (LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.not_isFiniteRepType_oneLoop). A representation of •↺ is a vector space V with an endomorphism f, and LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.affineE6LoopRep turns it into the representation of E₆~ with V × V × V at the centre, V × V at each inner vertex and V at each outer vertex. All its arrows are injective, so it is a configuration of three flags Lᵢ ⊆ Pᵢ of V × V × V:

    • L₀ = V × 0 × 0 inside P₀ = V × V × 0;
    • L₁ = 0 × 0 × V inside P₁ = 0 × V × V;
    • L₂ = {(x, x + f x, f x)} inside P₂ = {(a, a + c, c)}.

    This construction is fully faithful (LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.fullyFaithfulAffineE6LoopFunctor). A morphism between two such configurations preserves the first two flags, so its centre component acts on the three coordinates separately; preserving P₂ forces the three coordinate actions to agree, and preserving L₂ forces the common one to commute with the endomorphisms. The construction therefore preserves indecomposability and reflects isomorphism, and it preserves finite-dimensionality, so it embeds the finite-dimensional indecomposables of •↺, up to isomorphism, in those of E₆~. No algebraic closedness and no infinitude of the field is needed: the nilpotent Jordan blocks already give infinitely many indecomposables of •↺ over every field.

    Main definitions #

    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.affineE6LoopRep: the representation of E₆~ attached to a representation of •↺.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.affineE6LoopFunctor: the same construction, as a functor.

    Main results #

    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.fullyFaithfulAffineE6LoopFunctor: the functor is fully faithful.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.IsFiniteRepType.oneLoop_of_affineE6: finite representation type of E₆~ would force it on •↺.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.not_isFiniteRepType_affineE6: E₆~ has infinite representation type over every field.

    Implementation notes #

    LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.affineE6LoopRep carries @[expose] for the reason recorded in LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.RepresentationTheory.Quiver.OneLoop.FiniteRepType: a functor built by CategoryTheory.Paths.lift reveals its vertex spaces only through its definition, and the components of the functor on morphisms are typed by them.

    In the proof of fullness the components of a morphism are recorded as linear maps between products of the vertex spaces, so that its six naturality squares, read on elements through CategoryTheory.NatTrans.naturality_apply, are equations between pairs and triples which rw and simp can take apart coordinatewise.

    References #

    • I. Assem, D. Simson, A. Skowroński, Elements of the Representation Theory of Associative Algebras, Volume I, Chapter VII.
    • H. Derksen, J. Weyman, An Introduction to Quiver Representations, Chapter 4.

    noncomputable def LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.affineE6LoopRep {k : Type u} [Field k] (M : QuiverRep k Quiver.OneLoop) :
    QuiverRep k Quiver.AffineE6

    A vector space with an endomorphism, as a representation of E₆~. For a representation M of •↺, with vertex space V on which the loop acts by f, this is the representation of LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.Quiver.AffineE6 with V × V × V at the centre, V × V at each inner vertex and V at each outer vertex. The outer arrows are x ↦ (x, 0), x ↦ (0, x) and x ↦ (x, f x), and the inner arrows are (a, b) ↦ (a, b, 0), (b, c) ↦ (0, b, c) and (a, c) ↦ (a, a + c, c).

        Full faithfulness #

        The six naturality squares of g, read on elements. Each is CategoryTheory.NatTrans.naturality_apply along one arrow, whose action is the one recorded in the docstring of LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.affineE6LoopRep.

        source
        noncomputable def LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.fullyFaithfulAffineE6LoopFunctor (k : Type u) [Field k] :
        (affineE6LoopFunctor k).FullyFaithful

        The functor LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.affineE6LoopFunctor is fully faithful. A morphism between images is determined by its component ψ at the first outer vertex: by naturality along the six arrows, every other component is ψ, ψ × ψ or ψ × ψ × ψ, and ψ commutes with the loop.
